Coinbase CEO anticipates U.S. crypto regulations

Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong stated that clearer regulations for cryptocurrencies in the United States are forthcoming, regardless of Senate approval. He expressed optimism that these rules will be established soon. Armstrong also commented on charitable organizations, suggesting that most are 'net negative' and indicated he has no immediate plans to establish his own foundation.
